mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which lifts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing price index exceeding 5% signals weakening consumer balance sheets and reduced discretionary spending, which depresses earnings and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when HOUST falls by more than 5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production exceeding 2% signals deteriorating economic activity and lower corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO declines by more than 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 2.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures exceeding 3% signals weakening demand and lower earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS falls by more than 3% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that raises wage pressure and input costs, which reduces profit margins and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls by more than 0.3pp to below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in GDP growth below 1% combined with a 3-month decline in housing prices exceeding 2% signals a synchronized weakening in demand and consumer balance sheets, which reduces earnings and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during periods when both GDPC1 growth is below 1% and HOUST falls by more than 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
